seeds.title: read_rules takes samples, the spec names read_rules(repo)
seeds.detail: Spec section 2 lists read_rules(repo). The code has read_rules(repo, samples) per ADR f2cc. It also exports make_rule, github_rule, RULE_KEYS and GH_TIMEOUT, which the spec does not list.

seeds.title: Rule union deduplication is quadratic
seeds.detail: `if rule not in result["rules"]` scans a list. 5000 rules take 0.31 s, 10000 take 1.24 s, 20000 take 4.87 s. One call with 50000 rules took about 37 s. Real GitHub bodies are small.

seeds.title: Duplicate sample names overwrite by_sample
seeds.detail: samples [dup, dup] make two gh calls. The second body replaces the first under one key. A first body with rules and a second with [] gives by_sample {dup: []}.

seeds.title: A non-bool negate turns into True by bool()
seeds.detail: negate "false" gives true, and 1 gives true. GitHub sends a bool, so the effect is small. The spec says parameters.negate or false.

seeds.title: The failure note keeps all stderr text
seeds.detail: 200 KB of stderr with NUL and escape codes gives one note of 200045 characters, passed on unchanged. S-015 prints the note to a terminal.

seeds.title: Timeout note exposes the argv text
seeds.detail: The hung gh note reads: Command '['gh', 'api', 'repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/s1']' timed out after 60 seconds. It is correct but long.
